summary: Profusa filed an 8-K reporting entry into a material definitive agreement, a direct financial obligation, and unregistered sales of equity securities, announcing an October 15, 2026 issuance of a senior secured convertible promissory note to Ascent Partners Fund LLC. The note has a $769,230.77 principal amount for a $700,000 purchase price, matures October 15, 2027 or upon the Option Closing Date, bears 7% interest (18% on default), and is convertible at $4.28 per share with a $1.07 floor. This is a financing, not a special situation.
